ebay deep review: Rare Vintage Vincent Van Gogh Provencal Orchard From Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam — Stedelijk Museum licensed reprint/poster of Van Gogh drawing; decor.
ebay deep review: Vintage Chinese Carved Stone Seal Stamp with woman figurine — Modern soapstone (shoushan-type) tourist seal with red paste; not jade, $10-30 item.
ebay deep review: Enamel Buddha statue — Modern cast brass figure with worn cloisonne-style enamel and faux reign mark; decorative repro, not Ming.

ebay deep review: Ceramic vase with applied elephant head decorations in oxblood red glaze — Modern glazed ceramic vase with felt-covered base and crazed white earthenware body; decor, not Van Briggle/Zsolnay.

ebay deep review: E.R. Pfretzschner handmade violin 4/4, Roth Shop Adjustment, model 301. 1969 — 1969-70 Scherl & Roth imported E.R. Pfretzschner model 301 student outfit; sells ~$250-450, bid $135 + unknown ship leaves no 1:1 margin after 13% fees. Ref https://themusicden.com/e-r-pfretzschner-1974-model-301-4-4-stradivarius-copy-violin-outfit-used/ (needs sold check)

ebay deep review: ANTIQUE WOOD BAY POST NORTH BAY CANADA 2 BEARS FIGURE 14 1/2” long — Mid-century North Bay, Ontario 'Bay Post' souvenir: cast/composition bears on a varnished driftwood slab, not Brienz carving; $30-60 decor.

ebay deep review: Set of 2 1902 Edith Somerville Antique Fox Hunting Lithograph Prints 10x13.5 — Two colour plates removed from an E. Somerville book (c.1902 'All on the Irish Shore' era), not lithographs or drawings; book plates sell $15-40.

ebay deep review: HEY, HOW ARE YOU? HOW HIGH ARE YOU? HEY, HOW ARE YOU? HOW HIGH ARE YOU? — 1925 Round Oak Stove 'Doe-Wah-Jack' calendar print, trimmed, cut and with the calendar removed; $30-70 range, no margin at $35+6.
ebay deep review: Framed Schooner Sailing Ship Painting — Textured craquelure print of a Jacobsen-style schooner in a new gold frame, not an oil; decor value.

ebay deep review:  A Painting of a Woman with  her Children at a  Seascape Beach  — Don Hatfield-style beach-family offset print/serigraph in a 1980s pastel frame, one photo, unsigned in view; decor, and a large frame to ship.

ebay deep review: Framed "SPRING" by Sir John Lavery 12x16 Gold ornate frame home decor — Carolina Mirror / Crown Fine Arts canvas-textured reproduction of Lavery 'Spring'; label on the back confirms a factory decor print.

ebay deep review: Guisseppe Armani  HawkFigurine Statue Sculpture with Wings Spread on Wood Base — Florence/Capodimonte bisque hawk signed G. Armani with crown-N mark; common resin-bisque line, typically $50-150 sold, no margin at $70 plus shipping.
ebay deep review: Dale Kurtz Original watercolor painting landscape — Dale Kurtz 'Silver Peak Lookout' pen-and-wash, a regional decorative artist with no auction market; $115 already exceeds resale.
ebay deep review: Torrey Pines Golf Original Pastel Artwork — Contemporary 2026 pastel by a living golf artist; no secondary market, $200 opening.

ebay deep review: Ottoman-Early 1900 Turkish Poetery Book-islamic theme-Farsi Writing And Printed — Lithographed (printed) Ottoman-Turkish Mevlid/hikaye chapbook, cover missing, not a manuscript; $50-150, no margin at $145+18.50.

ebay deep review: Vintage Chinese Red Coral Hand carved Snuff Bottle  2.5" Tall X 1.5 Width. — Red 'coral' snuff bottle with orange-white core under red skin and pitting, consistent with dyed or reconstituted coral; material would need testing (authentication), and no margin at $139.

ebay deep review: Antique Bohemian Ruby Glass With Lid-Raised Enamel Flowers And Gold Chloride — Late 20th-c Czech/Venetian-style ruby covered goblet with raised enamel and gilt, not antique Moser; $40-80 sold, under the $50 profit floor.

ebay deep review: Harmony H167 Acoustic Guitar Made In USA In 1970 — 1970 Harmony H167 (F-70 stamp) needing a neck reset, binding and pickguard work; $150-250 in that state, no margin at $150 plus shipping.

eBay golden-egg review: Modern Chinese brass boy-on-buffalo censer, export decor — Machine-crisp casting, uniform artificial patina, rivet-on saddle cover: 20th-c./recent decor, not Ming/Qing.
eBay golden-egg review: Thad Cox 2004 face jug, 8.5in, contemporary Southern potter — Signed 2004 contemporary maker, not Meaders/early Southern; $120 at/over typical resale.

eBay golden-egg review: Weidlich Brothers (WB) #4193 cast-metal basketball trophy, 1929, engraved plate — Production trophy topper (bronzed white metal); WB trophies sell ~$50-150, $120 leaves no margin.
eBay golden-egg review: Later 'Made in Japan' reprint of Bairei-style rooster & hen, signed/sealed in block — Stamped 'Made in Japan' (post-1921 export reprint); $150 bid exceeds typical $40-100.
eBay golden-egg review: 1980s studio raku globe vase, unsigned, felt-dot base — Glazed raku with luster, not San Ildefonso burnished blackware; unsigned studio piece.
eBay golden-egg review: Amber carnival-glass swung/funeral vase, moulded feather pattern — Pressed iridized carnival glass with moulded ribs, not Favrile/Aurene/Loetz; $104 above value.

eBay golden-egg review: Modern resin faux-amber bead necklace, crackle inclusions, lobster clasp/extender chain — Modern resin with crackle-effect 'inclusions' and costume findings; not amber or Bakelite.
eBay golden-egg review: Timex Indiglo ladies two-tone 'President' quartz, 1999 — Timex dial/caseback, Indiglo; a Rolex homage, not a Rolex.
eBay golden-egg review: Ihagee Exakta VX IIa with Meyer Primotar 50/3.5, untested — Already ended 13:06Z; common untested East German SLR (~$60-120).

eBay golden-egg review: Nelson Rhodes 'Distant Spring' offset-litho limited edition (1,000/1,500 American Masters Foundation affidavit on back) — Mass-produced 1980s Texas bluebonnet print with affidavit; $25-75 decor value.

eBay golden-egg review: 1960s Bangkok tourist-market impasto oil of Wat Pho/Grand Palace spires, signed 'Kid' (Thai) — Common 1960s Thai souvenir oil by minor painter; resale $150-350, already $200 with 2 bids.

eBay golden-egg review: Faux-folk horse painting on board with deliberate crackle medium, unsigned (Warren Kimble/Ryan Fowler-style decor, c.1990s) — Crackle is applied finish and design is 1990s country-decor style, not antique American folk art; unsigned, ~$50-150.
eBay golden-egg review: Small carved soapstone/alabaster howling bear figure, modern souvenir — Modern tourist stone carving, not pre-Columbian; <$50.

eBay golden-egg review: Textured canvas-transfer reproduction of Hubert Robert 'The Fountains' (Art Institute Chicago) in decorator frame with brass plaque — Printed reproduction (brass title plaque, paper label, board backing); $30-60, plus $32 shipping.
eBay golden-egg review: Modern black nephrite/hetian archaistic double-dragon pendant on green cord with gold-tone spacers — Contemporary China-market archaistic pendant, not period jade; $20-60.

eBay golden-egg review: Chinese bronze tripod censer, compressed body, loop handles, ruyi-lappet band, single-character 宣 (Xuan) mark in round recess; 10.5 cm, 481 g; probably late Qing/Republic, apocryphal Xuande mark — Good form, patina and worn feet look right, but seller's AI-template text and many modern repros on market; cannot rule out 20th-c. copy. Small single-char-mark examples resell ~$300-500. Max $125 keeps profit >= cost at $350 resale. Not an egg: small size and single-char mark cap value well under $1k.

eBay golden-egg review: Rookwood 1929 production matte blue two-handled vase, shape 77C, 5.5 in — Correctly identified common Rookwood production piece, $100-175; at $60+$10 ship with 2 bids, no margin after fees.

eBay golden-egg review: Two modern smoke-fired earthenware tripod/handled jugs, incised signature 'RCM..' on base (Latin American folk souvenir) — Signed modern craft pottery, not pre-Columbian or early Native; <$40.

eBay golden-egg review: Birks 'Rideau' automatic, gold-plated 34mm, caseback engraved 1964 presentation — Gold-plated Birks house-brand, not solid gold or Omega/Longines; resale $80-150 vs $53 bid, profit < cost.
eBay golden-egg review: Innovative Time (ITC) quartz two-tone dive-style watch, model MD951WY — Cheap fashion quartz homage, $10-25.

eBay golden-egg review: Konica Big Mini F (BM-302) compact 35mm, tested, with leather case — Correctly titled hyped camera, already $200; will be sniped to ~$300-400, leaving profit < cost after 13% fees.
eBay golden-egg review: Contemporary amateur realist mountain-lion oil signed J Ralph Mayes 2011, not plein air school — Hobby painter, decor value <$200; $200 start already exceeds value
eBay golden-egg review: 20th c. decorator copy of Stuart Athenaeum Washington, cheap frame, severe blistering — Flat crude handling + modern molded frame; not period Stuart-school; flaking paint
eBay golden-egg review: Armando Gentilini 'Precious' 1960s Windsor Art offset litho print 11x14 — Mass-produced decorator print (LITHO IN USA on face), $10-20
eBay golden-egg review: Unsigned amateur lake landscape oil in 20th c. composition gilt frame — Naive handling, no signature/label; decor $30-80

eBay golden-egg review: Japanese kakejiku, rooster & hen with morning glory, ink & color on paper, signed 秋堂 (Shudo) with seal; competent Meiji/early Showa Shijo-style bird-and-flower painting — Quality hand painting (not a print) with real seal; artist minor/unidentified so not an egg. Only one photo, fb-0 seller: confirm no roller damage/print before bidding. Resale $200-300 on eBay/Chairish.
eBay golden-egg review: Iron mokko kiku (chrysanthemum) tsuba, crisp uniform cast look, unsigned — Common type heavily reproduced; even genuine unsigned Edo kiku tsuba ~$50-150, no margin at $50
eBay golden-egg review: Modern Chinese soapstone ('Shoushan') tiger-knop seal, 8in/2.5kg, cyclical-date inscription — Oversize tourist-export seal, common; $181 start above resale
eBay golden-egg review: Dale Costner (Vale NC) contemporary Catawba Valley face-jug birdhouse — Living contemporary potter, comps ~$50-150; $98 start leaves no margin; not Meaders/early
eBay golden-egg review: Anne Klein signed gold-tone shell-heart brooch — Signed costume Anne Klein, $10-25; not 18k/Tiffany

eBay golden-egg review: Mixed loose gem lot (topaz, kyanite, iolite, sphene, opaque-looking grandidierite, jadeite slab) — Mostly <$10/ct material; grandidierite looks dark/opaque low grade; lot resale ~$60-100, IDs unverified, 2 bidders already
eBay golden-egg review: Orange dyed wood/sponge-type chunky bead necklace — Speckled matte dyed beads, not natural Mediterranean coral; <$20
eBay golden-egg review: 2025 Pieces of the Past Royalty Edition Marie Alice Heine handwriting relic card — Modern cut-relic card, $5-25; authentication-dependent

eBay golden-egg review: Edna Hibel 1992 Grenchen Art Museum exhibition poster (offset print, inscribed) — Printed exhibition poster; the 'gilt frame' is part of the print. Hibel posters sell for $20-60.

eBay golden-egg review: Small Japanese print of Nijo Castle (二條城) with kites, mid-century souvenir, Woodward & Lothrop frame label — Mid-century Kyoto souvenir print, worth $30-80, so $90 is already above value.

eBay golden-egg review: Continental portrait miniature after an 18th-c. English portrait (Cosway/Reynolds style), c.1900-30, brass filigree frame, faux-tortoise back with AH monogram — A c.1900 decorative copy, not a Georgian original; the $130 opening bid is about its value.
eBay golden-egg review: Two private-mint USA250 'Morgan Dollar Tribute' gold-plated/ruthenium novelty medals — Plated novelty medals with no precious-metal content and no gold nuggets.
eBay golden-egg review: Japanese ink hanging scroll, robed figure with calligraphy inscription — Auction already ended.

eBay golden-egg review: Hiroshige I, Vertical Tokaido (Gojusan tsugi meisho zue) no.13 'Numazu, Ashigarayama Fuji no yukibare', 1855 design; title wrongly says Hiroshige II / 36 Views of Fuji — Edition unproven. The closeup shows only a round 実-type seal under the signature, with no visible Tsutaya ivy seal or aratame/date seal, which suggests a Meiji-Taisho recut or later reprint ($80-200). If the margin seals are hidden under the mat and it is an 1855 original, it is worth $600-1,500. Ask the seller for an out-of-frame photo. Bid $120 max blind; bid up to $350 only if the seals are confirmed

eBay golden-egg review: Bohemian papillon/oil-spot iridescent vase on dark amethyst ground, c.1900-10, 8in, pinched baluster form (Rindskopf/Kralik type, possibly Loetz) — Shipping is $25, and there are no photos of the base or pontil. Modern Czech/Chinese papillon copies exist, so ask for a base photo; a polished pontil and wear point to period glass. Unsigned period Bohemian papillon realistically resells for $250-400 on eBay, and a Loetz attribution would be worth more.
eBay golden-egg review: Fenton 2007 Family Signature hand-painted satin aubergine vase, #5, S. Stephens — Late Fenton, not Galle/Daum cameo glass; these sell for $50-120.
eBay golden-egg review: Oscar de la Renta Parfums promotional quartz watch, gold-tone — A perfume gift-with-purchase watch, not a Cartier; the auction has also already ended.

eBay golden-egg review: Baltic amber round-bead necklace, cognac with sun-spangle (heat-treated/pressed) beads, sterling clasp — Modern treated cognac amber, not old opaque cherry amber; worth $80-200, so no margin at $100.
eBay golden-egg review: Green marbled plastic/Bakelite oval-bead stretch bracelet — Marbled plastic swirl, not jadeite; Bakelite bracelets like this sell for $30-80.

eBay golden-egg review: G.A. Pfretzschner (Markneukirchen) stamped 4/4 violin bow, round pernambuco-type stick, ebony frog with pearl eye, white-metal fittings — Title only says 'G.A.'. The fittings could be nickel (then worth $300-500) rather than silver ($600-900), and the bow likely has imitation-whalebone lapping and needs a rehair. Shipping cost is not stated, and the stick has not been checked for cracks or straightness. Cap the bid at $170.
